title: Work Out Every Morning, Not 3 Times A Week
hook: Here's why you should work out every single morning.
body: Most guys go to the gym two or three times a week for an hour and a half, get sore, miss a day, and within a month they're not going at all. A short workout every day means you never have to decide if today is a gym day. Even 10 or 15 minutes is fine. Do it first thing, before anybody needs anything from you.
close: Save this and start tomorrow morning.
